title: Canterbury Museum, Christchurch

terrainReference.basis: Original Rolleston Avenue-side terrain near the photographed porch. Exact historic doorstep grades are approximate.

mapIdentity.provider: OpenStreetMap way 23504437 version 7 and the historic versions of its twelve nodes preserve the January 2016 perimeter. Heritage New Zealand list entry 290 identifies the Gothic Revival street range at 15 Rolleston Avenue.
mapIdentity.scope: OSM way 23504437 version 7 and all twelve contemporaneous node positions establish the museum perimeter in January 2016. The Gothic street range and entrance face east along Rolleston Avenue.

note: The January 2016 public-domain exterior records the dark masonry and pale trim, tall traceried windows, open porch, rose window and tower’s steep truncated roof. The connected rear galleries follow the archived outline with approximate roof subdivisions.
